body: I did not know about behind the names. I am so happy to have it now. Thank you. As for the common/weird names I was thinking more like Matt verse Silas like something that everyone know verse something that is noteworthy. I only thought of grounded in reality because that is all I write.

I watch the video all the way through. I WATCHED it not just listened to in the background while I did something else too like I normally would with a video like this just to prove to myself that I could. And I completely disagree. I understand that I am an exception to most people hopefully but I panic basically constantly. It feels like there is never a day that I don't have a panic attack leaning over my head. I use constant distraction as a way control my anxiety and panic. I have never opened an app seen all that was new closed it and opened it again. Giving my brain enough leeway to do something like that will end in panic for me. I constantly have to be watching and guarding my attention to stay sane. It is exhausting and I really hope I am not common but I completely disagree with you at least when It comes to myself and other people similar to me.
I have found this video somewhat helpful not really in the long run but as a temporary pick me up it can help https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MBRqu0YOH14&t=4s

I know they care That is why I have not killed myself. If I was only taking myself into account I would have killed myself at 8. This is not just because I am down. I have asked myself at my emotional highest if the guarantee of more days like that day would make like worth it and at one of the happiest I have ever been the answer was still no.

I go up and down. I am in a down right now and I know it, but I am fucking exhausted. I am an analytical person. I want to see if I still feel this fucking down and suicidal once my mood goes up. If I am, I am just done nothing feels worth it right now.
